data.title: Seashore
data.about:
Mina Rashid Seashore is an aesthetically pleasing ode to Dubai’s rich history and legacy. This deluxe residence is named after the Sirdhana—the British Royal ship that was first to dock at Mina Rashid in 1970.

Here, you can select from a collection of 1, 2, 3-bedroom apartments and 4-bedroom penthouses featuring spacious balconies, floor-to-ceiling windows, shimmering glass facades, stunning waterfront views, and lavish interiors. What’s more, a myriad of brilliant amenities awaits you, making it the perfect spot to wake up, to create memories with your family, and to enjoy a deep slumber every night.
